collections.description:

So, we're taking time this Valentines month (a day just isn’t enough anymore) to share some coffee love with a range of feel good bundles that you and your loved ones can start incorporating into your everyday lives.

collections.title: Aluminium Capsule
collections.description:
Enjoy Specialty Coffee with Our Convenient Coffee Capsules

Elevate your daily coffee routine with our coffee capsules, designed for quick, mess-free brewing that brings the taste of India’s finest specialty coffees to your cup. Crafted from high-quality aluminum and nitrogen-flushed to lock in freshness and flavor, these capsules offer the perfect blend of convenience and exceptional quality.

Brewing Café-Style Coffee at Home Has Never Been Easier

With our coffee capsules, you can brew café-quality coffee at home in just seconds. Simply insert a capsule into your Nespresso®* or Nespresso®*-compatible machine, press the button, and enjoy a rich, full-bodied espresso. Each capsule delivers the perfect shot of espresso, which can be used as the base for your favourite drinks—whether it’s a bold Americano, a creamy latte, or a frothy cappuccino.

Choose from four delicious variants of our coffee pods, featuring diverse roast profiles from medium to dark, including popular options like Attikan Estate. These capsules are available in packs of 16 or 36, making them ideal for coffee enthusiasts brewing solo or sharing with friends.

For over 11 years, Blue Tokai has been your go-to destination to buy coffee beans online, offering India’s finest freshly roasted coffee beans and ground coffee. Our commitment to quality and craftsmanship has made us a favorite for coffee lovers across the country.

collections.title: Blue Tokai Taster’s Club
collections.description:
Let our roasters guide you through the world of specialty coffee!

Our Blue Tokai Taster’s Club is an example of interactive exploration in a box. It’s an initiative to engage, educate, and create a community around coffee while understanding specialty coffee through unique tasting exercises developed by our roasting team. Our roasters will guide you through the different facets of specialty coffee and will share the decisions they had to make that influenced the flavour of the coffee that you’ll be tasting with each box.

You will receive a box themed around a different coffee topic each month. We’ll be covering everything from the basics of roasting to understanding different processing methods, and how all of this impacts the final flavours in your cup. The box and modules will be curated by members of the roasting team at Blue Tokai every month and will contain 3 different coffees for tasting, a handbook that delves deep into the theme for that month, and an exercise to try at home.

Each Taster’s Club member will also be invited to join an exclusive coffee community on a Discord server. The server will be a shared platform for continued engagement for the duration of the episode where members will be encouraged to share their results and experiences from the exercise, ask questions to our roasters. Each episode will also be supported with a video by our roaster who will guide you through the episode’s topic and exercise.

collections.title: Channi Coffee
collections.description: Instant coffee is made by freeze drying pre-brewed filter coffee to make it soluble in water and is not freshly roasted. The packaging process gives it a longer shelf-life so it can be stored in supermarkets for longer. While convenient to prepare, instant coffee is not fresh and lacks the flavour and unique characteristics that you can taste in brewed coffee. Channi coffee is just as easy to prepare and is ready in just 4 minutes!

collections.description:

Each kit comes with three 75 gms coffee pouches and a Channi to get you started. It also comes with a detailed guide on how to brew your coffee - including the temperature of the water, ratio and brew time.

collections.title: Cold Brew Bags
collections.description:
Want to brew smooth, refreshing cups of coffee without special equipment? Our cold brew bags have you covered. With a selection that caters to diverse palates, you can choose between easy-to-craft brews that are rich and smooth, fruity and refreshing, or juicy and sweet.

The best part? Crafting cold brew with our cold brew bags is simple and straightforward. Just steep them for 14-18 hours, either in your fridge or at room temperature. And voila! You'll wake up to great-tasting cold brew that you can savour all day. Simply pour into glass, add ice as desired, and enjoy! You can also steep longer for a more intense brew.

Our cold brew bags also go great with refreshing recipes. For instance, you can mix cold brew with sparkling tonic water and garnish with a lemon wedge... and there you have it, a delicious mocktail! Stir in a dash of milk, add chocolate syrup, and a cafè mocha is ready. Blend in a generous serving of condensed milk to enjoy Vietnamese-style coffee. The possibilities are endless!

Each cold brew bag is nitrogen-flushed to retain freshness and flavour. So, you can even take some along on your travels, and craft delicious cold brew while on the go. The coffee used in our cold brew bags is the same as what you get in our retail pouches, and each bag can be stored for up to 6 months from the date of packaging.

Available in boxes of five, our cold brew bags are available for purchase online on our website, through Swiggy and Zomato, on the Blue Tokai app, and in our cafés. Each bag brews 3 glasses of coffee.

collections.title: Easy Pour
collections.description:
Our Easy Pour coffee sachets change the way you brew specialty coffee, making it more convenient than ever. With no special brewing equipment, and just a few minutes of your time, you can enjoy great-tasting coffee wherever you are.

Each coffee sachet is thoughtfully designed with a built-in filter filled with ground coffee from one of our trusted partner farms. To preserve the freshness of coffee, Easy Pours are nitrogen-flushed. This means that you don't lose any aroma and flavour until you’re ready to brew.

Using Easy Pour sachets is simple and straightforward. Begin by placing the filter over your cup, utilizing the side anchors to secure it in place. Then, slowly fill the filter with hot water two to three times, allowing it to steep through the coffee grounds. Think of it as brewing a pour over, but instead of a V60 dripper, you're using an Easy Pour sachet, anchored onto a cup.

Our Easy Pours come in convenient packs of 5 and 10 single-serve coffee sachets, and are perfect whether you want to enjoy convenient coffee at the comfort of your home, during office breaks, or on the go. They're also a great entry point into the world of specialty coffee since all you need to brew them is hot water. Get started with our single estate Easy Pours or grab our mixed bag to explore diverse roast and flavour profiles.

And if you want to enjoy the Easy Pour experience, but with a coffee of your choice... our portable drip coffee filters have you covered!

collections.title: Taster's Club 2022
collections.description:
Want to dive deeper into the world of specialty coffee — right from varieties to processing, down to the nuances of roasting?

We’re back with the second season of Taster’s Club and if you’re curious to know more about the world of specialty coffee, you should sign up.

Each episode delves into a specific topic and comes with a handbook, an exercise and a little kit for you to get hands-on with. In addition to the monthly box that includes 3 x 75g coffee pouches, an SCA flavour wheel, an exercise worksheet and a digital handbook, you will also have access to a community of curious coffee enthusiasts; full of questions, discoveries and fascinating discourses on specialty coffee in India.

The second season of Taster’s Club has 9 episodes on offer, broken into 3 themes of 3 episodes each. We will be disclosing topics for 3 episodes at a time — below are the first 3: 

  1. Peaberries
  2. Fruit Fermentation
  3. Yeast Fermentation

Orders for the upcoming episodes will be open till 5th of every month and your boxes will be dispatched on the 7th (if not the weekend).
